name: 🥕 Greek Yogurt Veggie Dip
tagline: Creamy tzatziki-style dip made with plain Greek yogurt, cucumber and garlic, with crunchy veggies.

items.name: Salt, and dill if we have it

steps.text: Grate the cucumber and squeeze it dry in a paper towel.
Stir it into the yogurt with the garlic, lemon, olive oil and a big pinch of salt.
Rest 5 minutes so the garlic mellows.
Cut the pepper into strips and arrange all the veggies around the dip.

chef_tip: Squeeze the cucumber dry. Skip that and the dip turns watery in 20 minutes.
make_ahead: Dip keeps 3 days; veggies cut ahead keep in water in the fridge.
leftovers: Perfect sauce for Greek Chicken Naan night.
swaps: Ranch seasoning instead of garlic and dill
